summary: Backend Phase 2 (Categories + Cities) fully verified. 25/25 pytest cases pass (100% success rate) including admin auth JWT, Categories CRUD with auto-slug + slug uniqueness + applies_to validation + cycle detection + delete guards, public DB-backed /api/categories shape, Cities CRUD with lat/lng/radius bounds + slug uniqueness + active filtering + distance sort, public /api/deals & /api/merchants city filtering (san-francisco slug returns filtered result; unknown slug silently ignored), and Phase 1 regression on /api/admin/dashboard, /merchants, /deals, /customers. Cleanup verified — no TEST_ residue left in DB.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_panel.py:_would_create_cycle walks up only 20 hops — deeper trees could bypass detection, but limit is reasonable for real-world category depth.

admin_panel.py:delete_city has no in-use guard (unlike delete_category). If a city with claims/merchants tied to it is expected to be protected, add a similar merchant/deal usage check; current spec only calls out that behavior for categories, so this is acceptable.
server.py:_resolve_city uses $or across slug/id — unknown slug returns None so filter is silently skipped as spec requires; verified.
admin_panel.py update_category returns 'existing | {"_id": None}' when no updates — includes _id key with None value; harmless but slightly leaky. Consider returning the cleaned doc consistently.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 city 'San Francisco' (slug: san-francisco, lat 37.7749, lng -122.4194, radius 25km) — retained intentionally because public feed city-filter test requires it. All TEST_ prefixed categories and cities were cleaned up.
